title: Pacific nations await climate billions, as fossil fuel divide looms over Cop31
description: Ahead of next month’s United Nations Cop31 climate summit, as a strengthening El Niño drives Pacific sea temperatures towards record levels, more than $5 billion promised to the region remains unpaid. Cop31 co-hosts Turkey and Australia are pushing to speed up the switch to electric transport, heating and industry, but participating countries are divided over how to wind down the use of coal, oil and gas.

title: Ancient Circular Marble Monument Found Around Jesus Tomb in Jerusalem
description: Archaeologists uncovered a 20-foot-wide circular marble monument around the venerated Jesus tomb in Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre, detailed in a new 605-page report.

title: Denmark’s shift from fossil fuels to electricity is accelerating
description: Electric cars, heat pumps and electric boilers are driving a sharp increase in the share of Denmark’s energy consumption covered by electricity. Denmark is becoming increasingly electrified as electric cars, heat pumps and electric boilers replace fossil fuels. title: Piece together ancient Roman luxury with Marble Mosaics
description: Yorkshire stone specialists Lapicida are bringing 2,000 years of Italian craftsmanship into British homes with its stunning new Marble Mosaics collection, as Graham Walker has been finding out.
